title: 萤火虫森林
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied black-and-white coloring page of two cute fireflies and two broad leaves. Make ONE focused simplification: completely remove all four dangling legs/feet from both fireflies, and completely remove BOTH raised outlined white arms, so the two insects float happily with broad simple bodies and wings only. Replace the left insect's support gesture if necessary by a single solid-black curved line from the side of its head/body toward the underside of the large overhead leaf; this line must have no outlined white interior, no fingers, no loop. Do not add any other arms, legs, hands or feet. Keep both faces, the two broad body/abdomen color sections per insect, both broad wings, the large umbrella-like top leaf and broad ground leaf, all their positions, scale, clean organic contours and pure white background unchanged. These are coloring regions for children's fingers: no narrow white enclosed tubes, no extra detail, no textures, no shading, no text. Preserve smooth crisp black contour and generous closed main shapes. Required end state: 8-10 large white enclosed coloring areas plus background, zero tiny limb areas. Remove the six thin white arm/leg shapes, do not merely shorten them.
previousPrompt:
Edit the provided image as a professional children's coloring-book illustrator. Maintain the established confident flowing black contours on pure white, playful organic shapes, and generous finger-coloring areas. No shading, gray, color, texture, text or watermark. Hard maximum20 white enclosed coloring regions across the whole picture, with no substantive tiny/narrow white compartments.

Keep the warm cheerful two-fireflies-and-one-large-leaf story, but simplify substantially to about8–12 LARGE closed white shapes, hard max20 including background. REMOVE ALL thin doubled-outline arms, hands, legs, feet, antenna loops and the long leaf stem. Make antennae and any supporting arms SINGLE solid-black open strokes only, not tubes with white interiors; no white interior loops. Both fireflies hover happily just below the umbrella leaf; each has one big head/body, one large soft wing, and abdomen divided into only2 broad segments. Keep the single broad ground leaf, empty background, solid-black eyes and smiles. No new scenery.
